---
title: "pathway level canonical neuron analysis"
output: html_document
date: "2026-09-18"
---

```{r setup}
library(BPCells)
library(tidyverse)
library(sccomp)
library(readxl)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
set.seed(1)
dreamlet_results<- qs2::qs_read("../shared objs and code/dreamlet_de_results_all_contrasts.qs2")
dreamlet_results = dreamlet_results %>% filter(cluster%in% c("40_Mch","19_Orexin_Hypocretin","15_Histaminergic","100_Avp_Magnocellular","101_Oxt_Magnocellular","2_Ghrh_Galanin Neurons","41_Agrp_Npy","41_Agrp_Npy","54_Pomc_Cartpt","8_Prlh", "55_KNDy","44_Glp1r_Lepr","36_Slc17a6_Nts", "51_Slc17a6_Ptger3_Gpr83"))
#didn't include some neurons (ex: Gnrh/ TIDA) bc low counts 

clusters_of_interest = dreamlet_results$cluster %>% unique


# Loop over each contrast
gsea_results_list <- list()

comparisons_of_interest = dreamlet_results$comparison %>% unique
for(cur_cluster in clusters_of_interest) {
  cur_data = dreamlet_results %>% filter(cluster == cur_cluster)
  for (contrast in comparisons_of_interest) {
      cur_data_contrast <- cur_data %>%
       filter(comparison == contrast) %>%
        arrange(-logFC)
    # Build named gene list (ranked by logFC)
  
    cur_genelist <- cur_data_contrast$logFC
    names(cur_genelist) <- cur_data_contrast$gene
    cur_genelist <- sort(cur_genelist, decreasing = TRUE)
    
    cur_fgsea = gseGO(geneList = cur_genelist,
                          OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db,
                          ont = "BP",
                          keyType = "SYMBOL",
                          pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                          pvalueCutoff = 1,#don't remove any 
                          by = "fgsea",
                          nPermSimple = 50000,
                          seed = TRUE,
                          eps = 1e-50,
                          verbose = FALSE)
    gsea_results_list[[cur_cluster]][[contrast]] <- cur_fgsea %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        mutate(contrast = contrast) %>% 
        mutate(cluster = cur_cluster)
  }
  
}
all_gsea_results <- bind_rows(
  lapply(names(gsea_results_list), function(cluster) {
    bind_rows(gsea_results_list[[cluster]])
  })
)


saveRDS(all_gsea_results, "gsea_results_canonical_neurons.rds") 

qs2::qs_save(all_gsea_results,file =  "gsea_results_canonical_neurons.qs2")
```
